parameters.content:
## StockFlow · New and changed order alerts

Local, rule-based and $0 in OpenAI usage.

**Tracked templates default to notificationsEnabled: false. Gmail setup was canceled.**

All five workflows use one encrypted Discord webhook credential. No input can select another URL or channel. Each message identifies its intended owner or administrator; owners receive no emails or direct messages. All ASCII at-signs are displayed as [at] to neutralize mention syntax. Link previews and TTS are disabled. Long details have an explicit truncation notice.

1. Create a webhook for your chosen private text channel.
2. Import it using configure-discord.mjs and send one labeled connection test.
3. Enable critical alerts only after confirmed delivery.

Critical stock and new/changed orders: every 15 minutes. Daily digest: 09:00. Open-order follow-up: 10:00. Inventory audit: Mondays at 09:30. All times Asia/Kolkata.

Critical alerts and follow-ups have a 24-hour successful-delivery cooldown; zero-stock escalation sends immediately. Order updates establish an initial baseline without historical messages. State advances only after Discord confirms a message ID. Data audits never modify inventory.

The API login and Discord URL stay in encrypted n8n credentials. Source: automations/DISCORD.md.
